rules.name: stalled-pipeline
rules.text: Ask when no stage progress is reported for 15 minutes.

rules.name: nan-base-loss
rules.text: Stop when base-training loss is NaN or infinite on three consecutive reports.

brief.question: Does the completed d12 model reduce the silent-versus-visible accuracy gap observed at d6 under the frozen suppression protocol?
brief.healthy: Base training resumes at step 2000 and reaches 5000. Trace SFT ends at 62 steps, direct SFT at 40 steps, and each evaluation covers 400 prompts.
brief.noise: Torch compile and FlashAttention fallback warnings are expected on MPS. The first training step is slower, and periodic validation can reduce throughput.
brief.worth_a_flag: Resume below step 2000, a duplicated 48000-row mixture, unexpected SFT step totals, incomplete 400-prompt evaluations, or a missing training process.
brief.decided: The task, seeds, model depth, 5000-step base budget, one-epoch SFT arms, greedy decoding, and endpoints are frozen. This run changes no scientific condition.
